description: This file defines the 'ColumnLeft' class in the OpenCart admin controller namespace. It extends a system engine controller and primarily implements the 'index' method, which constructs a multi-level menu hierarchy for the admin panel. The menu includes sections like Dashboard, Catalog, CMS, Extensions, Design, and various others, with checks for user permissions to determine which menu items are visible.

classes.name: ColumnLeft
classes.description: Controller class responsible for building the admin panel's left sidebar menu with sections like Dashboard, Catalog, CMS, Extensions, Design, and others, based on user permissions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Builds and returns the HTML string for the admin panel's left menu, checking user permissions and dynamically generating menu items for various sections such as Dashboard, Catalog, CMS, Extensions, Design, etc.
